name: Halpati Housing Scheme
benefit: - Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 provided for construction of housing.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should belong to the Halpati (Talaviya, Nayaka) caste, which is recognized under Scheduled Tribes. 1. The applicant should be a resident of South Gujarat districts: Surat, Tapi, Valsad, Navsari, Narmada, Bharuch, Chhotaudepur, or Vadodara. 1. The applicant should be a resident of rural areas within the specified districts.
